title: Spatial ECM-omics via MALDI-MS Imaging
author: Brittney Gorman
materials: High pH tissue buffer (TRIS 10 mM pH 9)
Low pH tissue clearing buffer (Citra Buffer)
Complete by rinsing in 100% distilled water
Select the measurement regions in FlexImaging

steps.title: Remove Matrix
steps.instruction: Remove the matrix from the sample using 50% ACN for 1 min.

steps.title: Perform Tissue Buffer Washes
steps.instruction: Sequentially submerge the sample in the following buffers for 1 min each: High pH tissue buffer (TRIS 10 mM pH 9), Low pH tissue clearing buffer (Citra Buffer), and water (H2O).

steps.title: Prepare TRIS Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of 10mM pH 9 TRIS Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 0.6 g Trizma base (MilliporeSigma Catalog #T8937).
Adjust pH using NaOH and HCl.

steps.title: Perform Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Process slides in a 5-slide mailer with side opening using the prepared TRIS buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add ~10 ml of buffer to the mailer.
Place no more than 3 slides per mailer; positions 1 and 5 must face inward to the solution (not toward walls), and position 3 may face either way.
Fill the remainder of the slide mailer with buffer.

steps.title: Cool and Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Cool the slides after antigen retrieval and wash to remove buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place the mailer in a tub of cool faucet water, ensuring water does not go over the top of the mailer.
Remove half of the buffer from the mailer and replace with distilled water.
Repeat the water replacement step 2x.

steps.title: Dry Slides
steps.instruction: Dry the slides for 5 min in the desiccator.

steps.title: Wash Syringe and Lines
steps.instruction: Clean the sprayer lines and syringe.

substeps.instruction: Wash syringe lines with 0.1% TFA for 5 min at 55 µl/min.
Wash syringe lines with H2O for 5 min at 55 µl/min.

steps.title: Prepare Collagenase III Syringe
steps.instruction: Prepare the dedicated Collagenase III enzyme solution syringe.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the syringe with water by screwing in the needle tip, filling with 3 or more ml of water, and aspirating into waste.
Fill with Collagenase III solution, ensuring no bubbles are present.
Tip: After loading, pull a small volume of air into the syringe and gently dispense until the large air bubble is gone.

steps.title: Configure Matrix Sprayer
steps.instruction: Set up the TM-Sprayer™ (or M3-Sprayer) for Collagenase III application.

substeps.instruction: Place samples in the sprayer tray and fasten with tape.
Program the COL3 method: 45 °C, 15 passes, 25 µl/min, crisscross pattern, velocity of 1200 mm/min, 3 mm track spacing, and dry time of zero.
Set the spray head tip 50 mm from the slide surface.
Remove the needle tip and fasten the syringe to the Collagenase III line on the red syringe pump, ensuring the rate is 25 µl/min.

steps.title: Apply Collagenase III
steps.instruction: Apply the enzyme solution to the target tissue.

substeps.instruction: Use a dummy slide to check the nozzle; spraying typically starts after 2-3 min (200 µL).
Once moisture is detected on the dummy slide, press Start on the M3-Sprayer to apply a thin layer of Collagenase III to the target tissue.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate the slides in a controlled environment to maintain enzyme activity.

substeps.instruction: Place the ITO slide on top of a 50 ml glass beaker inside a sealed incubation chamber.
The chamber must be filled with 150 ml saturated KNO3 solution and pre-incubated at 37.5 °C.
Incubate for 5 hrs at 37.5 °C.

steps.title: Post-Incubation Drying
steps.instruction: Remove the slide from the incubation chamber and let it dry in the desiccator.

steps.title: Prepare CHCA Matrix
steps.instruction: Prepare CHCA matrix at 7 mg/ml in 50% ACN / 1% TFA / 10mM monobasic ammonium phosphate.

steps.title: Apply CHCA Matrix
steps.instruction: Set up the TM-Sprayer according to the guide with the following parameters: Temperature 79°C, 12 passes, velocity 1300, and 2.5 mm offset.

substeps.instruction: Place the slide in the MALDI holder and load it into the timsTOF flex.
Adjust the TIMS pressure to ~1.8 mBar using the knob above the syringe pump.

steps.title: Perform N-glycan Preparation
steps.instruction: Perform N-glycan preparation and imaging following protocol dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8epv5j1m4l1b/v4.

substeps.instruction: Vortex briefly and sonicate for 15 min.

steps.title: Configure ECM Analysis Method
steps.instruction: Load and tune the method for ECM analysis.

substeps.instruction: Set parameters: Scan range 700 - 3000 m/z, Ion polarity Positive, 400 shots at 10,000 Hz.
Tune parameters as displayed for the timsTOF fleX ECMomics method.

steps.title: Calibrate Method
steps.instruction: Calibrate the method in ESI mode while infusing Agilent Tune Mix (G1969-85000, Catalog #G1969-85000).
